techniques.name: Seoi Nage
techniques.description: Seoi Nage, or shoulder throw, is a classic Judo technique where you throw your opponent over your shoulder.
commonMistakes: Failing to secure a strong grip
Lifting with the arms instead of using the legs

applications.selfDefense: Effective for taking down an attacker quickly
applications.competition: Widely used in Judo competitions at all levels

techniques.name: O Goshi
techniques.description: O Goshi is a hip throw where you lift and throw your opponent over your hip.
commonMistakes: Not getting close enough to the opponent
Bending at the waist instead of using the hips
variations: Tsuri Komi Goshi (lifting pulling hip throw)

applications.selfDefense: Powerful throw for neutralizing an attacker
applications.competition: Frequently used scoring technique in Judo

techniques.name: Uchi Mata
techniques.description: Uchi Mata, or inner thigh throw, involves using your inner thigh to sweep your opponent's leg and throw them.
keyPrinciples: Turning your body into the throw
Using your leg as a lever
commonMistakes: Not getting deep enough with the leg
Failing to turn the hips sufficiently

applications.competition: Highly effective and dynamic throw in Judo matches

techniques.name: Harai Goshi
techniques.description: Harai Goshi is a sweeping hip throw where you use a sweeping motion with your leg to take your opponent down.
keyPrinciples: Kuzushi with a strong forward pull
Timing the sweep with the opponent's movement
commonMistakes: Sweeping too early or too late

applications.competition: Commonly used in Judo competitions for its versatility

techniques.name: Tsuri Komi Goshi
techniques.description: Tsuri Komi Goshi is a lifting pulling hip throw where you lift your opponent while pulling them over your hip.
keyPrinciples: Strong pulling action with the arms

applications.competition: Highly effective throw in Judo competitions, often used as a counter
